description: The declaration-slot rule returns its findings in SOURCE ORDER across both declaration slots, not just within one. `define repeat` (line 7), `struct if` (line 10), and `define while` (line 11) interleave `ProcedureDef` and `StructDef`, and the three findings must appear in that order. Source order rests on the walk's pre-order alone. One walk emits BOTH `ol-reserved-word` and `ol-duplicate-definition`, so source order also has to hold ACROSS the two codes -- which it does by construction, and which splitting the rule in two would have broken by grouping findings per code. `"check": true` -- nothing is executed and no events are produced.
